sloka: शिखिनी मन्मथ आर्तैः एषा भर्तारम् गिरि सानुनि ।ताम् एव मनसा रामाम् मयुरोऽपि अनुधावति ॥४-१-३९॥
transliteration: śikhinī manmatha ārtaiḥ eṣā bhartāram giri sānuni ।tām eva manasā rāmām mayuro'pi anudhāvati ॥4-1-39॥

translations.english: 'Overwhelmed with love, the enchanted peacock, spreading his wings is running after her, making sounds, as though mocking her.
